title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
title_zh: AutoPILOT：面向实时游戏的视觉智能体运行框架
abstract_en: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA, and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost. Our results suggest that how a harness turns model outputs into actions over time is a central yet underexplored part of agent design, and we hope AutoPILOT and AFK-Bench will serve as a foundation for agents in a world that does not wait.
abstract_zh: 多模态基础模型在可以暂停的游戏中表现出色，却常在游戏持续运行时失手。论文发现，这一差距很大程度上来自智能体运行框架（harness）：它决定模型看到什么、记住什么，以及如何将模型输出转化为随时间执行的动作。VISTA 等现有框架改善了感知与记忆，但每次模型调用最多只产生一个动作，使行动频率受限于模型推理频率。AutoPILOT 允许模型在单次调用中发出原子动作、启动开环宏，或编写闭环控制器。闭环控制器可根据画面持续操作，无需再次调用模型，直到交还控制权。为评估实时游戏能力，论文构建了 AFK-Bench，包含 120 款按游戏在玩家不操作时的反应分组的浏览器游戏，均支持实时与暂停时钟两种模式。在相同预算下，使用 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 AutoPILOT 在 AFK-Bench 上的实时成功率为 68.6%，高于 VISTA 的 38.3%；在 GameWorld 上，AutoPILOT 的实时成功率为 80.0%，而 VISTA 从暂停模式的 84.1% 降至实时模式的 42.9%。优势在不同模型上均有体现，且 AutoPILOT 仅用 VISTA 五分之一的 API 成本即可达到后者的最终成功率。
key_points_zh: VISTA 每次模型调用最多执行一个动作；AutoPILOT 让行动频率不再受模型调用频率限制。
AutoPILOT 支持三种执行方式：原子动作、开环宏，以及根据画面反馈持续行动的闭环控制器。
AFK-Bench 收录 120 款浏览器游戏，按游戏对玩家不操作的反应分组，支持对比实时与暂停模式。
相同预算下，AutoPILOT 将 AFK-Bench 实时成功率从 VISTA 的 38.3% 提高到 68.6%；在 GameWorld 实时模式下，两者分别为 80.0% 和 42.9%。
优势在不同模型上均有体现；达到 VISTA 的最终成功率只需其五分之一的 API 成本。

agent-multimodal.reason: 核心贡献是把实时屏幕观察与动作执行连接起来：模型可选择单步动作、开环宏或闭环控制器，后者无需再次调用模型即可根据画面持续行动。同预算对照显示实时成功率提升，但摘要未单独验证各组件的作用。
